published_title: Odds Say You Will Bring Him Before Me
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sachmo''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: This is an idea I thought off just recently, because after a local tournament not too many people had numbers protection.  And the start makes for a big surprise.
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The post does not mark starting cards. Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place is the objective; Start Your Engines! is shown as the starting interrupt (the description says 'the start makes for a big surprise', and the deck runs Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer and Watto's Box). All cards count toward the 60.
Posted 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order (missing from the machine draft; restores the total to 60).
Dark pages dested for the dual-printed cards: Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Endor (Dark).

Posted 'BHBM' dested Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place; 'DS2 Throne Room' / 'DS2 DB' Death Star II: Throne Room / Docking Bay; 'Zuckuss in MH' / 'Bossk in HT' / 'Dengar in PO' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Dengar In Punishing One; 'Shut Him Up...' Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down; 'Mob Points' Mobilization Points; '3720 to 1' 3,720 To 1.

Posted 'Omni Box x2' dested the plain Ommni Box interrupt (It's Worse x2 is listed separately, so not the Ommni Box & It's Worse combo); 'I Have You Know' dested I Have You Now; 'Counter Assualt' Counter Assault; 'Insignifcant Rebellion' Insignificant Rebellion; 'Start Your Engines' Start Your Engines!.
Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
Sense is kept as plain Sense (the post does not say which printing).
